1. Start Spotify playback on this phone.
2. Open Settings → Modes and Routines → Routines → +.
3. Choose an If trigger. For a physical key, look for Routines+ → Button action if installed and supported.
4. Then → Apps → Open an app or do an app action → Media Actions → Next track (or another action).
5. Save, test unlocked, then securely locked with the display off.

Menu names and available buttons vary by firmware. Record whether unlock is requested and whether the display wakes. If the action is missing or blocked, this integration is unverified for your firmware.
Transparent, resizable media controls with adjustable icon size and spacing.

Turn off automatic spacing to enter an exact gap (0–144 dp), or use −/+ for 1 dp steps. Gaps separate the touch areas; visible icon spacing also depends on icon size. Widen the widget if the requested gap does not fit.
Enter a whole number from %1$d to %2$d.
Check the highlighted number fields before saving.
Widget size reported by host: %1$d × %2$d dp
Preview gap: %1$d dp · center distance: %2$d dp
Requested %1$d dp; only %2$d dp fits at this size.
The host has not reported this widget’s size. This is a sample; the widget uses a 0 dp gap until its host supplies dimensions.

Vertical padding accepts negative values to expand controls upward/downward. The host may clip them; this cannot enlarge the LockStar slot. Horizontal padding stays nonnegative. Positive padding is limited to preserve touch areas.
Effective preview padding: horizontal %1$d dp · vertical %2$d dp
Requested padding: horizontal %1$d dp · vertical %2$d dp. Limited by widget size.
Individual button outlines with transparent centers. Independent of the whole-widget border.
One rounded outline around the whole widget. The inside stays transparent.
Choose a preset or enter #RRGGBB / #AARRGGBB. AA controls opacity.
Add Media controls to your home screen or LockStar first, then return here to edit it.
Default appearance for new widgets. Widgets edited individually keep their own settings.
Changes apply only to this widget.
This widget is no longer available. Close this page and add it again.

In Good Lock → LockStar, enable lock-screen editing and open the widget area or Add widget control, if available. Choose Media Actions → Media controls, place it, and drag its resize handles. Menu names and sizing depend on your LockStar version.\n\nThe three buttons work directly without opening this app. Grant Notification access here first to synchronize Play/Pause with the player. The widget has no song title. Touch feedback is a temporary ripple; the background remains transparent. Locked interaction and LockStar compatibility need testing on your phone.
Optional. The circle appears only during confirmed playback and updates every 5 seconds with the screen on. It is hidden when paused or unavailable. This indicator does not seek.

Spotify connected, but did not confirm playback. Open Spotify and check your login and last queue.

Spotify resume is already in progress.
Media shortcuts and a widget that fits your screen.
Edit one installed widget, or set the appearance for new ones.
For new widgets and those without individual settings.
Sample wallpaper and progress. These controls do not play music.

The launcher or LockStar may omit or misreport its location. Select it here to recognize this instance. This label does not move the widget or change its appearance. Save to keep it; cancel to discard.
Applies to every widget with track progress enabled. Turn the indicator on or off in each widget editor.

Play/Pause changes still update immediately. Periodic updates stop when paused, the screen is off, duration is unavailable or all indicators are disabled. A screen being on does not guarantee the widget is visible. Longer intervals mean fewer periodic updates; battery savings have not been measured.
